title: Tissue Determinants of Human NK Cell Development, Function, and Residence
data_availability_statement:
Further information and requests for reagents should be directed to and will be fulfilled by lead author Donna L. Farber ( df2396@cumc.columbia.edu )
This study did not generate new unique reagents.
The processed data and transcriptome dataset generated during this study is available on NCBI GEO with the accession number GEO: GSE133383 .

evidence.section: High-dimensional parameter flow cytometric analysis of NK cell subsets
evidence.quote: NK cell populations (defined as live, CD45 + CD14 − CD19 − CD3 − CD56 + lymphocytes) were exported and high-dimensional analyses were performed using the R-based workflow publicly available at https://github.com/ParkerICI/flow-analysis-tutorial and https://github.com/ParkerICI .
evidence.context: Data were analyzed with FlowJo 10.2.
